version: 2

models:
  - name: stg_orders
    description: One row per source order, including all lifecycle statuses.
    config:
      meta:
        owner: data-platform
        lifecycle: active
        grain: order_id
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        description: Source order identifier.
        data_tests: [not_null, unique]
      - name: customer_id
        description: Customer that placed the order.
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: status
        description: Current order lifecycle status.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [completed, refunded, cancelled]
      - name: order_date
        description: Date the order was placed.
        data_tests: [not_null]

  - name: customer_orders
    description: Completed-order metrics at one row per customer; refunded and cancelled orders are excluded.
    config:
      meta:
        owner: analytics
        lifecycle: active
        grain: customer_id
    columns:
      - name: customer_id
        description: Customer identifier and model grain.
        data_tests: [not_null, unique]
      - name: completed_order_count
        description: Number of completed orders for the customer.

  - name: daily_revenue
    description: Completed-order revenue at one row per order date; refunded and cancelled orders are excluded.
    config:
      meta:
        owner: finance-analytics
        lifecycle: active
        grain: order_date
    columns:
      - name: order_date
        description: Order date and model grain.
        data_tests: [not_null, unique]
      - name: completed_order_count
        description: Number of completed orders on the date.
      - name: completed_revenue
        description: Sum of completed order amounts on the date.

select
    order_date,
    count(*) as completed_order_count,
    sum(amount) as completed_revenue
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}
where status = 'completed'
group by order_date

select
    cast(order_id as integer) as order_id,
    cast(customer_id as integer) as customer_id,
    cast(status as varchar) as status,
    cast(order_date as date) as order_date,
    cast(amount as decimal(12, 2)) as amount
from {{ ref('raw_orders') }}

select
    customer_id,
    count(*) as completed_order_count,
    sum(amount) as completed_revenue,
    min(order_date) as first_completed_order_date,
    max(order_date) as latest_completed_order_date
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}
where status = 'completed'
group by customer_id
